propositions: Projects cannot currently extend built-in overlay triggers defined in the committed routing; trigger vocabulary must be added via a new project overlay mechanism.
The project overlay must support additive trigger_tokens (literal substring matching on diff lines) and applies_to (glob union) for entries keyed by built-in overlay ids.
Trigger extension keys must be read directly from the project routing file, not through effective_routing, to avoid replacement semantics that would break the additive union intent.
Token and glob extensions must be consumed in both glob_triggered_overlays and content_triggered_overlays by unioning them with committed triggers at call time.
With no project overlay present, both trigger functions must produce identical results to current behavior, preserving backward compatibility.
Malformed project trigger entries (non-list tokens, non-string token values, unknown overlay ids) must be silently ignored without raising exceptions.
